sentiment.rationale: The company raised its 2025 income growth guidance to 'around the bottom of 5-7% range' from a prior expectation of 'around the bottom of the 5-7% range', which is a meaningful upward revision. This is supported by strong operational momentum, including record net new money and double-digit income growth in key segments, and a confident management tone. However, the score is tempered by the fact that the guidance raise is partially attributed to a one-time $238m gain on the Solv India transaction, and the company still flags external risks such as trade policy uncertainty and geopolitical tensions.

summary.revenue: Underlying operating income of $10.9bn, up 9% (10% at constant currency) for H1'25. Q2'25 operating income of $5.5bn, up 14% at constant currency.
summary.eps: Underlying EPS of 139.2 cents, up 41% YoY. Reported EPS of 129.1 cents, up 55% YoY.
summary.guidance: 2025 income growth expected to be around the bottom of the 5-7% range at constant currency, excluding notable items. This is an upgrade from prior guidance which was also 'around the bottom of the 5-7% range' but the company now says it is 'tracking towards the upper end of the range' for the 2023-2026 CAGR.
summary.margin: Underlying RoTE of 18.1%, up 410bps YoY. Net interest margin of 2.05%, up 7bps YoY. Cost-to-income ratio improved to 54.7% from 57.0%.
key_risks: Elevated trade policy uncertainty and geopolitical change
Potential for a re-escalation of global tariffs
Sovereign risk and high government debt levels
Supply chain issues and key material shortages
Increased credit impairment charges in Wealth & Retail Banking due to higher delinquencies in unsecured portfolios
Operational and Technology risks remain elevated
key_opportunities: Record net new money in affluent business, with a target of $200bn net new money from 2025 to 2029
Double-digit income growth in Wealth Solutions, Global Markets, and Global Banking
Unique network across Asia, Africa, and the Middle East to capture growth opportunities
Leading position in digital assets, including being the only GSIB to offer spot trading in Bitcoin and Ether
Sustainable finance income growth, on track to achieve $1bn target by 2025
Growth in cross-border income and intra-ASEAN corridor

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: The Group Chief Executive states 'Our strong first-half performance reflects continued successful execution of our strategy' and 'We're performing well, while keeping a tight grip on costs, credit risk and capital', indicating a confident tone.
